lead_melody_clarity.reason: generated lead motif is rendered and/or planned with repeated variation

hook_identity.reason: hook motif quality and early hook arrival

call_response_quality.reason: response motif or sample response supports call-response

vocal_texture_control.reason: weird vocal texture is demoted or not detected

sample_motif_usefulness.reason: sample motif role assignment and hook return

ai_randomness_reduction.reason: random AI sections/chops are reduced by arrangement

low_end_control.reason: sub mono and low-end safety processing

manual_logic_honesty.reason: manual Logic limitations and no unsafe claims

what_remains_manual: True stem-level rewrite requires stems or manual Logic editing.
